name: rollcall_vfrenzyshadow
about: Roll call: classname npc_VFrenzyShadow builds CNPC_VFrenzyShadow (factory 0x10375050). This hand-written, ownerless row has no enemy, hunt path or stored last position. NPCInit 0x10375c80 sets current/ideal HUNT (0xb); SelectSchedule 0x10375d90 falls through Human to Troika 0x102af660, whose expired hunt timer selects HUNT_FINISH (0x85). Its GET_PATH_TO_LASTPOSITION attempts the zero stored position, inside this arena's central cover block, and the navigator refuses: retail task arm 0x10285bb0..0x10285c87 reports NO_ROUTE (0xc). The roll call asserts this initialization/failure chain, rather than an Idle state that admission used to invent.
notes: The cast row is named playercontroller: the controller line's spawn renames the entity to it. Hand-written row: no authored row exists; the model is the record's choice, not retail's.
